note: Shoshone NF campground beside the North Fork Shoshone River in the Wapiti Valley, on US 14/16/20 about 45 mi W of Cody and 8 mi from Yellowstone's East Entrance. The footbridge across the river is closed after flood damage. Trailheads with public corrals 1.5 mi E lead into the Washakie Wilderness. --Claude
summary: FS page: 20 sites along the river, FCFS (no rec.gov listing), $25 cash/check, 16-day limit, 40-ft spurs, hard-sided units only (grizzly order; a motorhome qualifies), vault toilets + potable water + bear boxes. FS shows 'Closed for the 2026 season' (end of season; a Campendium review confirms a July 2026 stay). Stored waterfront evidence is wrong: the river runs right past the camp loops -> re-audit, likely riverview or creekside.
flags: WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT (stored 'not waterfront' rests on wrong evidence): the stored evidence says the river is '~250m S through continuous forest', but on NAIP imagery the North Fork Shoshone runs along the south edge of the camp spurs. Occupied pads on the west spur (~44.4708,-109.8915) sit ~15-25 m from the channel behind a fringe of riparian trees/brush, and the east spur (~44.4705,-109.8863) runs ~20-40 m from it. The FS page says '20 campsites along the Shoshone River', and a Campendium review dated July 29, 2026 says 'We stayed in site 10 directly on the river' (a 2021 review: 'River running on the side with several sites facing it', site 5). The channel measures ~24-30 m wide at the campground, so an on-water value would be creekside. Site numbers can't be placed on imagery (no site map, FCFS), so: recommend at least riverview, and creekside naming site 10 if the reviewer accepts the camper report. Esri imagery is cloud-covered over the loops.

Status: FS banner 'Closed for the 2026 season' (page updated Oct 15, 2026) reads as the seasonal close - the campground was open in summer 2026 (Campendium stay July 2026). Campflare reports it was closed all of 2025. No season dates on the FS page; a 2023 camper says it closes October 15. Season left unwritten.

Pin 44.47228,-109.88831 is on the entrance road at US 14/16/20; FS point 44.47107,-109.88946 (~160 m SW) is nearer the spurs. Under 250 m.
